hep_cross_provenance.note: production_manifest_commit/sha256 are the state AFTER the R8 Phase 0 driver-gate fix (PR #11) was merged on top of the PR #10 canonical merge; sigma/LHE/BR values below are unchanged by that fix (it only hardened event-count validation).

lhe_identity.note: canonical_uncompressed_sha256 is the physics-content identity (sha256 of the decompressed LHE byte stream) and is what any content-equivalence check must use. historical_relabelled_gzip_sha256_at_pr6_run_time is preserved, immutable provenance for the actual compressed bytes produced by PR #6's non-deterministic gzip.open writer and is not expected to be independently reproducible. deterministic_relabelled_gzip_sha256 is what the current scripts/relabel_lhe_pdg.py (fixed gzip mtime=0, empty embedded filename) produces today, confirmed stable across repeated runs; it differs from the historical hash by design (compressed-metadata only) while decompressing to byte-identical content -- verified via scripts/lhe_identity.py against the canonical input recorded above.

canonical_uncompressed_sha256 is the physics-content identity (sha256 of the decompressed LHE byte stream) and is what any content-equivalence check must use. historical_relabelled_gzip_sha256_at_pr6_run_time is preserved, immutable provenance for the actual compressed bytes produced by PR #6's non-deterministic gzip.open writer and is not expected to be independently reproducible. deterministic_relabelled_gzip_sha256 is what the current scripts/relabel_lhe_pdg.py (fixed gzip mtime=0, empty embedded filename) produces today, confirmed stable across repeated runs; it differs from the historical hash by design (compressed-metadata only) while decompressing to byte-identical content -- verified via scripts/lhe_identity.py against the canonical input recorded above.

relabel.script_sha256_note: script_sha256 tracks the current scripts/relabel_lhe_pdg.py (checked by scripts/verify_r8_artifacts.py against the live file on every --verify-existing run). PR #7 (post-merge closure) fixed atomic publish-on-validation, deterministic gzip output, and rejection of unclosed <event> blocks in this script; it did not rerun the relabel on the canonical LHE inputs, so relabelled_sha256 above remains the byte-for-byte output of script_sha256_at_pr6_run_time and must not be treated as having been produced by the current script version.
